name: 19610 · Wyomissing, PA
findings: ZIP 19610 (Wyomissing) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19610 (Wyomissing) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19610 (Wyomissing) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
